Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

March 15th 19/26

Sir,
    In consequence of a report that the rebels, led by Huang Hsin's son, would start a rising last night, the sentries and police patrols were doubled in Chapei, the City, and neighbourhood of the Arsenal.
    It is said that General Fong Nan Yoo方咸五 who came here on 8th instant, has sent a report to Peking saying that the troops here are not reliable, and urging the Government to send some fresh troops to Shanghai from the North.
    General Fong left for Nanking yesterday.
    In response to a telegram from Chiangchun Feng Kuo Chang, two rebel spies named Khong Tso Hyuin孔再兴 and Wong Hai Ching王海清 who were arrested in the vicinity of the Arsenal on 7th instant were sent to Nanking under escort yesterday.
    Four men, who had been handed over by the French Authorities for being concerned in the attack on a police Station near the West Gate at the time of the Chaoho incident, were shot at the Arsenal on March 14th.

                                Your Obedient Servant,

                                （签名）
                                Chief Detective Inspector.

（签名）
Captain Superintendent of Police.

情报官登记
编号....................171
日期..................26年3月15日....

上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处
（侦探股）

1926年3月15日

先生：
    鉴于有报告称，由黄兴之子率领的叛军将于昨晚发动起义，闸北、南市及兵工厂附近地区的哨兵和警察巡逻队已加倍部署。
    据悉，本月8日抵沪的方咸五将军已向北京发送报告，称驻沪部队不可靠，并敦促政府从北方派遣新兵赴沪。
    方将军已于昨日前往南京。
    为回复张作霖来自长春的电报，两名于本月7日在兵工厂附近被捕的叛军间谍孔再兴和王海清，已于昨日在押解下送往南京。
    四名因涉及“超和”事件期间袭击西门附近警察局而被法国当局移交的男子，于3月14日在兵工厂被枪决。

                                您顺从的仆人，

                                （签名）
                                总探长

（签名）
警务处总监
